meta.textSample: Scalar Field Legal Docs Pricing Login Try Now Scalar Field: Your AI Agentic Trading Desk Reinventing Trading Research, backtest, and deploy intelligent trading agents from idea to live execution. Your agentic trading desk, from research to live execution. ScalarField helps traders turn market ideas into AI agents that analyze data, connect brokerages, and trade equities, options, prediction markets, and pre-IPO names across venues. Run an actively managed agentic portfolio of the fastest AI-capex growers, rebalanced weekly. Build a Trump-hype agentic portfolio that buys the stocks he publicly champions. Sell weekly cash-secured puts on AAPL 5% OTM, rolling or taking assignment. Let Opus 4.7 actively manage my stock portfolio. Buy and sell SPY on RSI sig| Add Trading Platforms Add Data Sources Ultra Backed by Combinator One platform. Every venue. Connect your brokerage. Your agent handles the rest. Where institutional-grade financial agents think, act, and adapt. Supercharge your edge with automated insight and action — not just data. Talk to Us See it in action Sub-300ms from event to live trade. Every dataset is timestamped at ingestion, so your agent reacts in under 300ms to place live trades the moment a filing or headline lands, and you can backtest that same tick-to-trade edge on history before going live. Corporate Insider Transactions SUB-300MS FROM SEC FORM 4 FILING TO YOUR AGENT. Every insider trade carries both our pipeline timestamp and the official SEC filing time. Your agent sees the delta — that's the latency edge. Institutional Holdings (13F) SUB-300MS FROM EDGAR SUBMISSION TO YOUR AGENT. Pipeline timestamp vs EDGAR filing time on every record. Detect position changes before the rest of the street parses the filing. Real-Time News Wire 63+ PROVIDERS. SUB-300MS PIPELINE DELIVERY. Reuters, Dow Jones, Quartr, TradingView, and 59 more. Full-text search across tickers, geographies, topics, and urgency levels. Options with Full Greeks LIVE AND HISTORICAL. SUB-300MS QUOTE SNAPSHOTS. Screen the entire options universe by strike, expiry, and Greek ranges. Complete implied volatility surface at any point in history. Economic Releases POINT-IN-TIME SNAPSHOTS AT EVERY OBSERVATION. CPI, GDP, rates, employment — with full revision history. Know what the market knew at any given moment, not what was later revised. FRED + Macro THOUSANDS OF SERIES. SUB-300MS ON UPDATE. Rates, inflation, employment, GDP, money supply, housing, trade balance. The backbone for macro factor construction and regime detection. Tokenized Pre-IPO Equities SPACEX. OPENAI. ANTHROPIC. ANDURIL. Trade tokenized pre-IPO names via Jupiter on Solana. Full OHLCV and live pricing. Plus 48 tokenized public equities. Analyst Ratings SUB-300MS FROM FEED REFRESH TO AGENT DELIVERY. Pipeline timestamp and rating issuance time on every record. Enriched with analyst-level performance metrics — success rate, average return. What will your agent trade? Click any strategy to get started. Or type your own. DEEP LEARNING Gamma-Squeeze ML Your agent trains a model on price and options history, validates it on a backtest, then trades the live signal. COPY TRADING Congressional Mirror Your agent parses disclosures the moment they hit and mirrors the trades automatically. PREDICTION MARKETS Polymarket Whale Copy Your agent watches on-chain Polymarket activity and mirrors high-conviction bets within seconds. SHORT INTEREST Short-Squeeze Hunter Your agent screens short interest and days-to-cover, then rides momentum as crowded shorts unwind. BACKTESTED Momentum Rotation Factor-based with survivorship-bias-free data. Backtest across decades, then deploy live. TOKENIZED Pre-IPO Basket Diversified pre-IPO exposure via tokenized equities on Solana. Your agent rebalances and reports NAV. EVENT-DRIVEN Post-Earnings Drift Your agent reads the print and the reaction, then captures the post-earnings drift that follows big beats. MACRO Macro Regime Rotation Your agent reads FRED and economic releases to size risk up or down as the macro regime shifts. Scalar Field Scalar Field, Inc. is an SEC-registered investment adviser. Registration with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission does not imply a certain level of skill or training. Scalar Field provides AI-assisted trade execution technology infrastructure through its platform. All trade executions are initiated at the user's discretion. All investments involve risk, including possible loss of principal, and past performance does not guarantee future results. Information provided through Scalar Field's website and platform is for informational purposes only and should not be construed as investment advice, or a recommendation, offer, or solicitation to buy or sell any security. Scalar Field does not provide investment, legal, or tax advice. Users should consult their own legal, tax, or financial advisors before making investment decisions. Services are offered only to users in jurisdictions where Scalar Field is registered or exempt from registration. For additional disclosures and important information, please visit https://www.scalarfield.io/legal. Company Docs Blogs Agentic Trading Strategies What Is AI Agentic Trading?
